contract: A[M,K] INT8, B[K,N] INT8; arbitrary positive strides; symmetric zero-point; FP32 per-row/scalar A scale and per-column/scalar B scale; BF16 output, no bias; K<=131071 prevents worst-case int32 overflow. Original activation quantization unchanged.

gates.epilogue: exact explicit FP32 multiply-left-to-right then BF16
gates.high_precision_reference: at most1 BF16 ULP at larger magnitude, subnormal floor
gates.original_gemm: at most1 BF16 ULP, finite, shape/dtype identical
gates.integration: all8 ranks actually replaced, zero unexpected fallback, paired32 no stable-pass regression; compare free tokens and rollback. Pilot only, not full164 release gate.

fallback: Unselected layers and unsupported contract use original callable; evidence records fallback counts; selected unsupported shapes invalidate pilot coverage.
